scenes:
Give your study time
a clear plan.
Know what you are studying. Make time for it.
Start with your subjects. Give each one a name and colour, so your plan, sessions, and statistics stay connected.
In Command Center, set a weekly goal and spread the hours across your week. Planned time and completed study sit side by side.
Choose how to work: Pomodoro, your own countdown, or a stopwatch. Breaks are tracked separately.
Pick a subject and start. Pause when you need to, log a distraction, and resume the same session.
When you finish, rate your focus and write down what you worked on. Save the session, and that time counts toward your goals.
Your history keeps duration, subject, rating, notes, and distractions together. Filter it to find the work you want to revisit.
Statistics shows where your time went: by subject, across the week, and over the day. Change the range to compare a different period.
The goal planner lets you try a daily study target and see the pace needed for the week. Move the slider to compare the result.
The heatmap makes your study pattern visible, day by day.
